## Welcome to my site!

<img src="images/kdunn.jpg" style="width:20%">

My name is Katherine Dunn, I am a current MPH student at Columbia Mailman School of Public Health. With a background in Engineering and medical devices, my goal is to incorporate my epidemiological skill with my prior expertise to develop technologies and therapeutics that make a clinical impact. 

My specific interests are in aging-related chronic diseases, specifically, cardiovascular, and neurological diseases. I am interested in modifiable risk factors in chronic diseases, particularly physical activity and social engagement! 

## Personal Interests

Outside of my studies, I enjoy playing Sudoku, trying new restaurants in Manhattan, and lifting weights. I have been playing intramural kickball in the city since moving here in 2025.
